bearing.model.v1alpha1.Authority.schema..description:
Authority is a source's claim to be the source of record. It is a message
 so levels can be added later without breaking declarations or overrides.

authoritative.description: True when the source is the source of record. Default false.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Authority.schema..title: Authority

bearing.model.v1alpha1.ConflictPosition..description: ConflictPosition is one source system's side of a conflict.

^(sourceSystem)$.description: The source system (namespace), or a core group.

authority.description: Whether the system is authoritative for the field.

objects.description: The objects the system supports at or above the threshold.

source_system.description: The source system (namespace), or a core group.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.ConflictPosition..title: Conflict Position

bearing.model.v1alpha1.FactObject.schema.description:
FactObject is a fact's object: { "subject_id" } for a relation, or
 { "type", "value" } for an attribute.

type.description: An attribute's value type. Set with value.
type.title: Value Type

value.description: An attribute's value, in canonical form. Set with type.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.FactObject.schema.title: Fact Object
